correctness.rationale: For a compact perturbation X=T+K, |X|-cI is compact by quadratic factorization and inverse of |X|+cI. By compact spectral theory, beta_0 membership is equivalent to finite rank of the below-c spectral projection. On the span of the first m+j negative modulus eigenvectors, ||Tx|| <= (c-d_(m+j))||x||; intersect with the codimension-at-most-m subspace where ||Xx||>=c||x||, obtaining a j-dimensional subspace where ||Kx||>=d_(m+j)||x||. The min-max principle gives every claimed singular-value lower bound. The explicit polar-aligned clipping K_m=U E_-(I-Q_m) realizes all ranks simultaneously. Summing pth powers yields exact Schatten costs even for quasi-Schatten p<1; finite-rank obstruction and the repair threshold follow. A standalone checker passed 3000 finite assertions, supplementary only.

originality.rationale: The qualitative beta_0 compact-perturbation criterion is credited to Su--Zhang, and Schatten characterizations of scalar partial-isometry perturbations are credited to Bala--Golla. The retained sharp all-rank singular-value lower bound, simultaneous extremizer, exact optimal Schatten-p tail costs at every subcritical-rank budget, and one-sided ideal repairability threshold are absent from the inspected closest statement and proof texts. The published-finding corpus density and AN distance records are in the operator norm and do not entail the ideal-specific obstruction. value.rationale: The question quantifies precisely the perturbation size needed to repair the failure of norm attainment on reducing subspaces, an issue highlighted by the motivating 2026 compact/finite-rank stability results. It gives an exact simultaneous singular-value optimum for every allowed finite rank of residual subcritical directions and all Schatten exponents, and a sharp ideal-theoretic dichotomy that remains valid for arbitrary noncommuting perturbations. Infinite-rank defects exhibit arbitrarily small Schatten repairs but no finite-rank repair; logarithmic power-tail examples yield concrete critical exponents. This is a natural complete quantitative classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or mere finite experiment.
